search.label: Search droids in Progress
search.needsSummary: Where you will need this droid

progress.superConfirmBody: You leave {{currentCycle}} and start {{nextCycle}}. Rebirth #{{currentStep}} is closed in the app and the new Path begins at #1. This cannot be undone.

path.switchBody: Move to {{name}}. Your inventory stays. Rebirth progress stays unless you reset it below.
path.switchBodyReset: Rebirth progress on {{name}} starts at #1. This cannot be undone.
path.resetRebirthOnSwitch: Reset rebirth progress on the new Path (start at rebirth #1)

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.staleData: Game data may be stale; check Settings.
dashboard.hero: Next rebirth, inventory, and safe sells for Droid Tycoon.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.trackingOffHint: Turn it on in Settings if you want the app to check requirements.
inventory.emptyHint: Add the droids in your base so the app can compare them to the next rebirth.
inventory.removeConfirmBody: Removes {{name}} ({{tier}}) from your list. You can add it again later.

sell.title: Sell Center
sell.intro: Rebirths {{from}} through 40 on {{cycle}}. After Super Rebirth most droids reset, so plan the next Path yourself.
sell.emptyStateTitle: Add inventory to get sell advice
sell.emptyStateBody: Tell the app which droids you have so it can compare them to upcoming rebirths.
sell.sellableNotNeeded: Safe to sell {{name}} (×{{qty}}). Not used in any remaining rebirth on this Path.
sell.sellableExtra: Sell {{qty}} extra {{name}}. You only need one for what's left on this Path.
sell.useNextNote: Deliver on Rebirth #{{rebirth}}, then you can sell.
sell.upgradeRebirth: Bring {{name}} up to at least {{tier}} before rebirth #{{rebirth}}.
sell.safeNowHint: Based on rebirths you've finished through #{{rebirth}} and what's left on this Path.
sell.safeNowLine: In your inventory and clear to sell before the next rebirth.
sell.keepGroupFooter: Still needed in a later rebirth on this cycle.
sell.upgradeGroupFooter: Raise tier before the rebirth that requires it.
sell.sellableGroupFooter: Not needed in remaining rebirths; sell when you're ready.

sellAfter.heading: Sell later:
sellAfter.none: No requirement droids become free after this step.
sellAfter.fusionCautionHint: Recipe isn't fully verified. Check in game before selling.
sellAfter.fusionNote: Some droids stay marked for fusion even when rebirths no longer need them.

exportCycle.title: Download my cycle
exportCycle.hint: PDF for printing or PNG chunks for WhatsApp. Generated on your device; nothing is uploaded.
exportCycle.failed: Couldn't build the export. Try again.

shareExport.title: Share
shareExport.hint: App link, progress card, or WhatsApp, all generated on your device.
shareExport.footer: Nothing is uploaded to a server.

feedback.settingsHint: Report wrong data or suggest improvements in our WhatsApp group.

fusion.title: Fusion Lab
fusion.rulesFootnote: Fusion unlocks at rebirth #3. Fusion-only droids aren't required for rebirths (per sources).
fusion.helpsNextEmpty: Nothing flagged for your next rebirth yet.
fusion.resultTierRule: Result takes the lowest tier among the three ingredients.

rules.tierUp: Three of the same droid at the same tier fuse into one of that droid at the next tier.
rules.random: Three different droids of the same base rarity fuse into a random droid one rarity up.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Track Path, rebirths, and what to keep or sell. Island code 7865-8305-9184. Fan-made, not official.
onboarding.welcomeSub: Track Path, inventory, and what to sell, built for mobile while you play.
onboarding.welcomeFootnote: Fan-made. Not affiliated with Epic Games.
onboarding.cycleHint: You can switch Path later in Settings.
onboarding.themeHint: You can change this later in Settings, Appearance.
onboarding.progressTitle: Where are you on this Path?
onboarding.progressHint: How many rebirths have you already finished?
onboarding.featuresHint: Dashboard, sell lists, and export when you need them.
onboarding.featureProgressDesc: See the next rebirth and what you need.
onboarding.featureSellDesc: Know what's safe to sell before you rebirth.
onboarding.featureExportDesc: Share progress or export a cycle PDF.
onboarding.doneBody: Open the dashboard when you're ready.
